_comment: Tier-2: VTK output is added as vtk_output_process in the output_processes block of ProjectParameters.json. Pitfall (kratos.poisson #6). NOTE ON THE WRITTEN SIGNAL: this claim carries one of the five shared boilerplate Signal suffixes used across the Kratos catalog, which does not describe what actually happens. The real signal is recorded below and in the fixture output. Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The process module KratosMultiphysics.vtk_output_process imports and exposes the Factory the JSON block resolves to, and the underlying KM.VtkOutput class exists on core; neither is a ConvectionDiffusionApplication attribute. This is the API surface a generated ProjectParameters output block has to name correctly. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
